manifest.name: dsh-auto-continue
manifest.description: Auto-continue for the DeepSeek Harness: when a turn is interrupted by an exhausted model retry, a provider error, or truncated output, the plugin automatically sends 继续 so the work keeps running. Host half watches turn/end; browser half adds 开启/关闭 switches to the composer's + menu.

bundle.text:
# dsh-auto-continue bundle patch: one host-plane row.
#
# Applied after every bundle layer (dsh-base, dsh-web-app, …) and before the
# profile's own cordis.patch.yml. The row registers the plugin into the host
# plane; its `config` doubles as the `base` of the `auto-continue` settings
# namespace, so a user override written through Settings (or through the
# composer's "+" menu switches) wins over these defaults.
#
# Runtime configuration (all optional):
#   enabled          - master switch; this is exactly the field the "+" menu's
#                      开启/关闭 items write through the settings scope
#   prompt           - the text sent automatically (default: 继续)
#   delayMs          - settle delay after a turn ends before sending, so the
#                      session finishes flushing and any queued work can start
#   maxStreak        - cap on CONSECUTIVE automatic continuations; the counter
#                      only resets on a real human message, so an
#                      error -> continue -> error loop cannot run forever
#   onError          - continue after a failed turn (exhausted retries, provider
#                      errors, timeouts)
#   onMaxTokens      - continue when output was truncated at the token ceiling
#   onAborted        - continue after a non-user abort; a USER stop (`aborted`
#                      with cause `user`) is never continued, with no override
#   onBlocked        - continue after a blocked turn
#   includeSubagents - also manage subagent sessions (off by default: a parent
#                      orchestrator owns its children's turn structure)
#   announce         - reserved for surface reporting; the continuation is
#                      always recorded in the durable session log
- insert:
    - id: auto-continue
      name: dsh-auto-continue
      config:
        enabled: false
        prompt: 继续
        delayMs: 1500
        maxStreak: 12
        onError: true
        onMaxTokens: true
        onAborted: false
        onBlocked: false
        includeSubagents: false
        announce: true

readme.text:
> **DeepSeek Harness 的「自动继续」插件**：当一回话因为模型重试耗尽、供应商报错、
> 请求超时、或输出撞上长度上限而**异常结束**时，自动发送「继续」，让工作接着跑。
> 在聊天框「+」菜单里提供一行 **「自动继续」+ 滑动开关**（默认靠左「关」，点击滑至右侧「开」，
> 滑块上带「开 / 关」字样视觉反馈）。

[English](./README.en.md) · [设计大纲](./docs/DESIGN.md) · [部署文档](./docs/DEPLOY.md)

---

长任务跑到一半，常常因为一些「非用户意愿」的因素断掉：

- 模型供应商临时 5xx / 限流，重试几次都没救回来；
- 请求超时、网络抖动；
- 单次输出太长，撞上 `max-tokens` 天花板，话没说完就停了；
- 其他把一回话以**错误**结束的情况。

这些在 DeepSeek Harness 里最终都收敛成同一条事实：**一回话（turn）异常结束**，
会话日志里写一条 `turn/end` + 结构化的结束原因。本插件只盯这一条事实：
回合异常结束 → 等一个小的冷却时间 → 用 DSH 自己的公开 API
（`agent.followup()`，和「目标续跑」走的是同一条路）投递一条「继续」，
让对话继续。

readme.section: 为什么是这样做（而不是别的）
readme.text:
| 方案 | 评价 |
| --- | --- |
| 自己接管 `agent/request-error` 做重试 | ❌ 会和 `llm-retry` 抢同一个瀑布；重试策略该由 provider 配置决定 |
| 包一层 LLM 中间件重发请求 | ❌ 只能救「单次请求」，救不了「回合已经失败结束、但工作没做完」这个真正的场景 |
| **观察 `turn/end` + `agent.followup('继续')`**（本插件） | ✅ 用 DSH 自己的稳定事件与公开 API；对**所有**导致回合异常结束的因素统一生效 |

关键点：**它不关心是哪种中断**。模型重试、超时、供应商报错、输出截断——
这些在 DSH 里最终都变成一条 `turn/end` + 结构化原因。插件只对这一条事实做判断，
因此天然覆盖「等其他因素」。

- **聊天框「+」菜单**里多出一行：`自动继续` + 右侧滑动开关，默认靠左「关」，
  点击滑至右侧「开」，滑块上显示「开 / 关」字样。
- 开关走 DSH 自己的 settings 通道，**持久化**、刷新/重启后保持。
- 回合失败 / 输出截断后，**自动发送「继续」**，在对话流里显示为一条可展开的上下文行
  （不冒充用户消息，来源标注为 `plugin: auto-continue`）。
- **安全围栏**（详见 [设计文档 §5](./docs/DESIGN.md#5-安全围栏每一条都是防误伤)）：
  - 用户按「停止」**永不**自动续跑；
  - 人类插话即让路；
  - 只在真空闲时发，不打断正在跑的回合；
  - 连续续跑次数封顶（`maxStreak`，默认 12），防死循环烧钱；
  - 默认只管根 agent，不干扰子 agent 编排；
  - 不做「卡住看门狗」（长命令本就会长时间静默，那种看门狗必然误伤）。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | 总开关（「+」菜单的滑动开关写的就是它；默认关） |
| `prompt` | `继续` | 自动发送的正文 |
| `delayMs` | `1500` | 回合结束后等多久再发（留出结算时间） |
| `maxStreak` | `12` | 连续自动续跑上限，只被真实人类消息清零 |
| `onError` | `true` | 回合失败后续跑 |
| `onMaxTokens` | `true` | 输出截断后续跑 |
| `onAborted` | `false` | 非用户原因中止后续跑（用户停止不受此项影响，永不续跑） |
| `onBlocked` | `false` | 被阻断后续跑 |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | 是否也管子 agent |
| `announce` | `true` | 预留：是否把续跑记录进会话日志 |

详见 [部署文档](./docs/DEPLOY.md)。最简步骤：

```bash

readme.section: 2. 在 web profile 里登记
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add /root/普通目录/dsh-auto-continue

readme.section: 3. 把插件加入 bundle 列表（见部署文档），然后重启 dsh
readme.text:
systemctl restart dsh.service   # 或你的等价方式
```

重启后刷新页面，点聊天框的「+」，即可看到「开启自动继续 / 关闭自动继续」。

本仓库带三层测试，从单元到真实主机端到端：

```bash
node test/engine.test.mjs                       # 决策引擎：13 个用例
node test/e2e.test.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3098 /path/to/work   # 真实失败回合 → 自动继续 → 封顶

node test/menu.probe.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3098  # 需要 playwright
```

`e2e.test.mjs` 会起一个**没有可用凭证**的隔离 DSH 主机，让每次模型请求都真实失败，
然后断言：失败回合 → 插件真的发了「继续」→ 连续 `maxStreak` 次后真的停手。

> An **auto-continue plugin for the DeepSeek Harness**: when a turn ends
> abnormally — an exhausted model retry, a provider error, a request timeout, or
> output truncated at the token ceiling — the plugin automatically sends
> `继续` so the work keeps running. It adds a single **「自动继续」** row with a
> **slider toggle** to the composer's **「+」 menu** — default left 「关」 (off),
> click to slide right to 「开」 (on), with the 开/关 glyph on the thumb.

[中文](./README.md) · [Design outline](./docs/DESIGN.md) · [Deployment guide](./docs/DEPLOY.md)

---

In the DeepSeek Harness every one of those converges on the same durable fact:
a **turn ends abnormally**, recorded as a `turn/end` event with a structured
reason. This plugin watches that one fact: turn ends badly → wait a short
settle delay → send `继续` through DSH's own public API (`agent.followup()`,
the same path goal-round continuation uses) → the conversation resumes.

| Approach | Verdict |
| --- | --- |
| Take over `agent/request-error` and retry ourselves | ❌ Fights `llm-retry` on the same waterfall; retry policy belongs to the provider |
| Wrap the LLM stream and re-issue one request | ❌ Saves one request, not a turn that already failed while the work was unfinished |
| **Watch `turn/end` + `agent.followup('继续')`** (this plugin) | ✅ Uses DSH's own stable events and public API; covers **every** cause uniformly |

The key property: **it does not care which cause**. Retry exhaustion, timeout,
provider error, truncation — all become one `turn/end` + structured reason, so
the plugin judges that single fact and naturally covers "other factors" too.

Via Settings → Plugins → `auto-continue`, or the `config` block in
`cordis.patch.yml`:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | master switch (what the + menu writes; default off) |
| `prompt` | `继续` | text sent automatically |
| `delayMs` | `1500` | settle delay after a turn ends |
| `maxStreak` | `12` | cap on consecutive automatic continuations |
| `onError` | `true` | continue after a failed turn |
| `onMaxTokens` | `true` | continue after truncated output |
| `onAborted` | `false` | continue after a non-user abort (a user stop is never continued) |
| `onBlocked` | `false` | continue after a blocked turn |
| `includeSubagents` | `false` | also manage subagent sessions |
| `announce` | `true` | reserved: record continuations in the session log |

See [the deployment guide](./docs/DEPLOY.md). Short version:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-auto-continue

readme.section: add "dsh-auto-continue" to the bundle list (see DEPLOY.md), then restart dsh
readme.text:
```

After restart, refresh the page, open the composer's 「+」, and the `自动继续`
toggle row appears.

Three test layers ship in this repo:

```bash
node test/engine.test.mjs                                  # decision engine: 13 cases
node test/e2e.test.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3098 /path/to/work # real failed turn -> continue -> cap
node test/menu.probe.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3098             # + menu switches (needs playwright)
```

`e2e.test.mjs` runs against an isolated DSH host with **no usable credentials**
so every model request fails for real, then asserts: failed turn → the plugin
really sent `继续` → after `maxStreak` consecutive sends it really stood down.
